scripts.dev: tinacms dev --noTelemetry --datalayer-port 9007 -c "trap 'astro dev stop' EXIT INT TERM; astro dev && astro dev logs --follow"
scripts.check: bun run check:content && bun run check:blockquotes && bun run check:sanitize && bun run check:smartypants && bun run check:island-guard && bun run check:page-prose
scripts.build: tinacms build --noTelemetry --content=local --datalayer-port 9007 -c "export NODE_ENV=production && bun run check && astro check && astro build && node scripts/check-token-leak.mjs && pagefind --site dist/client && cp -r dist/client/pagefind public/"
scripts.build:cloud: tinacms build --noTelemetry --datalayer-port 9007 -c "export NODE_ENV=production && bun run check && astro check && astro build && node scripts/check-token-leak.mjs && pagefind --site dist/client && cp -r dist/client/pagefind public/"
scripts.build:local: tinacms build --noTelemetry --local --skip-cloud-checks --datalayer-port 9007 -c "export NODE_ENV=production && bun run check && astro check && astro build && node scripts/check-token-leak.mjs && pagefind --site dist/client && cp -r dist/client/pagefind public/"
scripts.preview: bun run build:local && npx wrangler dev -c dist/server/wrangler.json
